findings: The public series was published after the September 2025 federal curriculum release and uses the revised Primary 1-3 and Primary 4-6 subject structures.
It retains English Studies and Mathematics at both levels and includes the revised Nigerian History and Social and Citizenship Studies structure.
Its Primary 4-6 structure includes Basic Digital Literacy, Pre-vocational Studies and optional French/Arabic as listed by the Federal Ministry of Education.
Topic framing includes communication, problem-solving, collaboration, leadership, practical application and digital-era contexts consistent with the official competency-based implementation strategy.
limits: The official federal sources confirm structure, competencies and phased implementation, not this third-party weekly sequence.
The pages must not be described as an official NAPPS edition.
The pages provide alignment headings only and grant no model-training licence.
